text:
Juno: Quick heads-up 52 I'm opening a PR to combine several Console observability snippets into one 'wiring' guide that covers heatmap generation, tracehook header reconciliation, and cost/latency panel mapping. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/16789
DocsBot: docs-bot: PR 16789 opened by Juno. Lint & CI queued.
Felix: I'll own the Node + TS samples. Planning to add a tiny helper that tries base64 then hex decode, plus unit tests for header fallbacks.
Samira: I'll take Python snippets and draft the migration blurb for dashboards. Need to call out that p90/p99 are split now and bucket resolution changed.
Omar: I'll write the Dedicated customer note (billing delta guidance + how to opt into legacy mapping). Also adding an alert example for unit-cost regressions.
Tess: I'll port examples to Go and add a short nginx example for Private deployments (proxy header preservation). Also will include a note about common proxy header renames.
Juno: Header fallback suggestion for examples: prefer `trace_key` then `x-rd-trace` then `x-forwarded-trace`; if missing, infer from `span-id` and show the caveat.
Felix: Node snippet draft:
```js
// prefer new header, fall back to legacy
const raw = req.headers['trace_key'] || req.headers['x-rd-trace'] || req.headers['x-forwarded-trace'];
let trace = tryBase64(raw) || tryHex(raw) || inferFromSpan(req.headers['span-id']);
client.generate({ input, trace: { trace_key: trace } });
```
Samira: Python snippet preview:
```py
# pick new header or fall back
raw = headers.get('trace_key') or headers.get('x-rd-trace') or headers.get('x-forwarded-trace')
trace = try_base64(raw) or try_hex(raw) or infer_from_span(headers.get('span-id'))
client.generate(input, trace={'trace_key': trace})
```
Tess: Go sample (short):
```go
raw := hdr.Get("trace_key")
if raw=="" { raw = hdr.Get("x-rd-trace") }
dec, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(raw)
if err!=nil { dec, err = hex.DecodeString(raw) }
// attach dec to telemetry
```
Omar: Draft billing note: increased bucket granularity can surface a small short-term cost shift for Dedicated customers. Recommend enabling the `legacy_bucket_mapping` flag for 7 days while monitoring unit-cost alerts, then flip to v2. I'll add example queries.
Samira: Migration blurb: dashboards that used single `latency_ms` should migrate to `routing_ms + decode_ms`. Added sample mapping formula and a short table for common panels.
Felix: Tests: added three cases for header precedence (new, legacy, absent). Also asserting `new_bucket = clamp(1, 12, ceil(old*1.2))` mapping for the docs example.
Juno: Link-check request after CI. A bunch of older examples reference `/examples/old-heatmap`; we need redirects or to update links.
DocsBot: docs-bot: link-check queued post-CI.
Tess: I opened a tiny redirect PR in examples repo to route old-heatmap -> heatmap-v2. Link: https://github.com/redwood/examples/pull/402
DocsBot: docs-bot: CI passed. link-check: scanned 10 pages, found 1 redirect (old-heatmap) and 0 broken links after redirect PR.
Omar: Plan: once docs PR green, we'll squash+merge, then open a backport to `stable-legacy` with a compatibility code block and the `legacy_bucket_mapping` opt-in snippet.
Felix: Added a small note in the Node sample about performance: decoding is cheap but don't do it synchronously in hot paths; memoize per-request where possible.
Samira: UX nit: I tightened copy to avoid implying any latency increase; clarified that panel metrics are a re-organization, not added instrumentation.
Juno: Targeting merge Thu 11am PT if no further issues. I'll post a heads-up in #release-war-room before merging.
DocsBot: docs-bot: summary - participants: Juno, DocsBot, Felix, Samira, Omar, Tess; PR 16789 status: ready (awaiting scheduled merge).
Felix: Thanks all 52 will follow up if tests flake.
Samira: I'll publish the migration checklist to the docs release notes once merged.
Omar: I'll prepare customer comms and the Dedicated rollout playbook.
Tess: LGTM, merging after the scheduled window.
Juno: Appreciate the quick turnaround, team.
